purpose: Machine-readable source-to-question map for Boğaziçi dining PMR preparation.
claim_boundary: Public role listings are routing evidence, not customer validation.
Control-organization membership does not prove daily quantity or payment authority.
BUCampus and BUCard product existence does not prove historical data access.
Food-waste totals do not establish the causal share attributable to overproduction.
No item in this file may be promoted to INTERVIEW EVIDENCE without a real completed interview.

sources.title: University Executive Board Committees and Commissions - Dining Control Organization
public_facts: Boğaziçi publicly lists a Yemekhane, Yemek Pişirme ve Yemek Dağıtım Kontrol Teşkilatı.
Principal members listed at research date include Ayhan Soylu as president, Barış Pancar, Aygül Demir, Ahmed Musab Taş and Mustafa Tunç.
pmr_questions: Which record defines accepted contractor service quantity?
Are ordered, produced, delivered and served quantities distinguished?
How are shortages, substitutions, leftovers and service failures documented?
Who can approve a quantity or allocation change, and until when?

sources.title: Sustainable Food Choices on Campus
public_facts: The Food Services Branch page publicly lists Aygül Demir Yolasığmazoğlu as Branch Manager.
It publicly lists Barış Pancar and Gül Güler as Food Engineers.
It states that meals are prepared in the North Campus cafeteria kitchen and procurement-to-service stages are carried out by the contractor under an SKS technical specification.
unresolved: operational records visible to each role
pmr_questions: Walk through the most recent normal lunch from menu approval to final service quantity.
When are ingredients committed and when does cooking become costly to change?
Is production one batch or multiple adjustable batches?
What is recorded for produced, delivered, served, returned, leftover and discarded food?

sources.title: SKS 2025 Activity Report / 2026-2027 Goals
public_facts: The report displays 6 dining halls and 6,000 daily meals.
It reports packaged-meal distribution, a North Campus kiosk, a 2,386-participant satisfaction survey and BUCampus menu selection.
It lists daily meal rating through BUCampus among 2026-2027 goals.
sources.semantic_warning: Do not add displayed activity counts together without owner confirmation; they may use different denominators and counting semantics.
unresolved: whether packaged meals share the same production pool
when allocation by campus or channel occurs
whether BUCampus feedback is used operationally
whether any intent signal exists before the freeze point
pmr_questions: Are packaged meals planned from the same production pool as dining-hall service?
At what point is quantity split across campuses and channels?
Can surplus be reallocated between channels or campuses?
Are BUCampus menu-selection or rating signals used before quantity decisions?

sources.title: Campus Food Waste Tracking
public_facts: Boğaziçi publicly reports 48,251 kg total food waste for 2025.
The page publishes monthly food-waste values and amounts delivered to İSTAÇ for recycling.
unresolved: generation date versus collection date semantics
pmr_questions: What physical material enters the published food-waste total?
Where and when is it weighed?
Can pre-consumer surplus, preparation loss and plate waste be separated?
Which source record is authoritative for a prospective pilot?

sources.title: BİD Service Inventory / BUCard and BUCAMPUS
public_facts: The service inventory includes dining-related BUCard services.
The IT department publicly presents BUCAMPUS among university digital products/services.
pmr_questions: Are dining BUCard or QR events retained historically?
Can privacy-safe date x campus x meal-window aggregates be exported?
Are BUCampus menu-selection or rating events retained as aggregate counts?
When are these records available relative to the production freeze time?

sources.title: Mediko Dietetics
public_facts: Mediko publicly identifies Ayhan Soylu and Ahmet Musab Taş in dietetics-related pages.
The dining control-organization source separately lists Ayhan Soylu and a similarly named Ahmed Musab Taş.
sources.semantic_warning: The sources use Ahmet/Ahmed spelling variants. Do not silently normalize identity; verify in PMR if relevant.
pmr_questions: Which nutrition or gram constraints are non-negotiable when quantities change?
Are special-diet, vegetarian or vegan quantities forecast separately?
Which food-safety or nutrition requirements must remain outside automated optimization?

sources.title: Current 2026-2027 Boğaziçi food-service procurement
public_facts: Existing repository research records it as a 2026-2027 unit-price service procurement with 3.13 million listed meal units and TEMAŞ as current contractor.
pmr_questions: What is the operational name of the quantity sent to the contractor?
Which quantity is used for acceptance or hakediş?
Can the quantity be revised and until when?
Who captures financial value from improved quantity accuracy?

hypotheses.hypothesis: A daily production or allocation decision exists before service and can be changed at a useful time.
hypotheses.falsifier: Owner says quantity is fixed externally, too early, or cannot be adjusted materially.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Service-level quantity records exist and are usable for retrospective baseline construction.
hypotheses.falsifier: Records are absent, too aggregated, semantically inconsistent, or inaccessible.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Edible pre-consumer surplus is a material part of the tracked food-waste problem.
hypotheses.falsifier: Measured waste is dominated by plate, preparation, or other streams.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Campus or service-channel allocation is a distinct operational control point.
hypotheses.falsifier: Channels do not share a controllable production pool or allocation cannot change.

hypotheses.hypothesis: At least one privacy-safe demand or intent signal is available before freeze time.
hypotheses.falsifier: Candidate signals are unavailable, inaccessible, or arrive after the decision.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Improved quantity accuracy creates value for at least one decision owner without unacceptable shortage risk.
hypotheses.falsifier: Contract incentives neutralize value or service risk dominates.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Existing preference and feedback mechanisms leave residual uncertainty that justifies forecasting or decision support.
hypotheses.falsifier: Reservation, intent, or simple rules already remove the actionable uncertainty more cheaply.

interview_order: Food Services Branch manager plus one Food Engineer
Dining Control Organization owner/member for unresolved acceptance and contract-execution semantics
TEMAŞ local project or production operator
SKS senior owner for bounded approval or escalation
stop_browsing_require_primary_evidence: exact daily quantity owner and freeze time
pre-consumer share of the 48,251 kg food-waste total
operational use of BUCampus menu votes or ratings
